rejected_priority.question: Does the modeled Arg19-Ser5 network contribute to TDPn3 G7-M8 recognition? Its proposed preferential ES stabilization is not supported across the retained passing analogue predictions.

history.previous_priority: Four-condition R19A x S5A kinetic comparison, motivated by apparent contact loss in analogue sample0.
history.change: Withdraw the ES-preferential structural premise and defer the experiment as the leading next action.
history.reason: Three other author passing analogue samples retain the contact and the ES-like Ser5 rotamer. Sample0 was an unrepresentative state comparison; no new experimental result was obtained.

critique.state_selection: The motivating difference was selected post hoc from ES3 versus analogue0 and fails against three other saved passing analogues. Additional static curation should not be used to rescue it.
critique.chemical_role: Ser5 is P3 relative to G7-M8; its side-chain recognition contact is chemically distinct from Zn45 Y152 contacting the reacting P1 backbone. No residue correspondence or common energetic role licenses transfer of the Zn45 ground-state-stabilization interpretation.
critique.E26_and_coupling: S5A removes the Ser hydroxyl from both the R19 candidate interaction and the E26 network and changes hydration/packing. R19A can reorganize this network. A nonzero kinetic double-mutant interaction would demonstrate functional coupling in this construct, not an isolated R19-S5 bond energy. There is no close direct R19-E26 salt bridge in the three initially compared files (nearest side-chain heavy atoms exceed 5 A).
critique.alternate_cleavage: Reporter annotation includes cuts after3 and7, but only cut7 is supported by the retained TDPn3 reporter product mass. The unverified cut3 annotation cannot be dismissed or promoted to a measured rate. S5A changes P3 for cut7 and P2-prime for cut3; a gain in total fluorescence could change register or sequential fragment cleavage. Early bond-resolved products are essential.
critique.sequence_context: S5A is a mechanistic probe on an altered target sequence, not success at the original target. The author model represents ten residues and omits assay M11/L12; the reporter fusion and full-length TDP43 are additional contexts. Internal S5 is correctly mapped, but the local contact and kinetic effects do not automatically transfer between these contexts.
critique.concentration_and_identifiability: Source TDPn3 kinetics use nominal500nM enzyme with KM52+/-9uM. A change in substrate recognition can move KM outside a practicable substrate range; then kcat and KM cannot be independently identified. Source full-length assays use20uM enzyme against8uM substrate, so their product endpoint does not establish catalytic turnover or a steady-state rate. Nominal normalization is not measured active-site concentration.
critique.interpretation_limit: KM is not binding Kd, kcat need not isolate chemistry, and functional rate coupling is not automatically a binding free energy. A low-substrate efficiency null alone does not exclude compensating changes in kcat and KM.

measured_alternative.question: For Zn45 on the same S_ZnO36 reporter and cleavage channel, does the Y152F versus Y152I screen contrast survive protein-quality and product controls, and does it reflect catalytic efficiency, turnover, or both?

source_basis.source_text: Main text Fig4j and Supplementary Discussion5 propose preferential ground-state stabilization by Y152. Extended Data Fig6d reports six selected best-per-position single-mutant kinetic curves; this is not an unbiased matched F/I kinetic comparison.

measured_alternative.assay_scope: One assayed well per mutant, three WT and three blank wells; affinity-purified and nominal concentration-normalized at500nM enzyme,3uM substrate,5uM Zn. Fold RFU slope is not a measured kcat, and AF3 confidence is not a folding/active-fraction control. The normalization CSV contains dilution instructions, not independent achieved active concentrations.
measured_alternative.current_conclusion: Hydroxyl removal alone is insufficient for improved activity in this fixed-concentration screen: F and A are below WT while I is above WT. Phe is a closer aromatic-shape comparison to Tyr than Ile, but the substitutions still change packing, solvation and possibly enzyme competence; no isolated hydroxyl energy or kcat direction is established.
measured_alternative.existing_followup_and_raw_gap: Y152I/M/R/V appear in the exact19-member >1.5-fold list selected for HPLC retest; Y152F is absent. The source reports single-mutant kinetics in addition to combination kinetics, but the exact six identities and a matched F/I kinetic dataset are not verified in the retained material. All retained central-directory ranges were searched; no exact single-mutant kinetic member capable of settling F/I was identified. This partial inventory cannot prove the data are absent from the archive.
measured_alternative.one_next_information_gain: Prioritize a matched WT/Y152F/Y152I comparison on the unchanged source substrate and intended cleavage channel, if new measurements are authorized and the missing matched data are not already available. First establish reproducible product-resolved rate ordering with matched preparation/competence controls; then distinguish low-substrate efficiency from saturation-supported turnover. This is an experiment decision, not a protocol, design launch or execution claim.
measured_alternative.minimum_observation_that_changes_recomme: If independently repeated, bond-specific rates with comparable enzyme competence do not reproduce the opposite F/I directions, withdraw the screen-driven packing-versus-hydroxyl priority. If the directions survive but both variants raise saturation-supported kcat while F has poorer apparent efficiency, replace the simple opposite-catalysis interpretation with a turnover/recognition tradeoff. Existing exact matched kinetics could supply this observation without new laboratory work.
possible_outcomes: Opposite saturation-supported kcat effects with matched competence: hydroxyl deletion alone does not explain turnover gain; packing/preorganization becomes the stronger mechanistic lead, still without proving a microscopic step.
Both variants increase kcat but F decreases efficiency: altered kinetic partitioning/recognition can explain the fixed-concentration sign contrast; KM is still not Kd.
Preparation failure or changed cleavage register explains the contrast: stop the isolated Y152 chemical interpretation and preserve the failure.
measured_alternative.no_new_raw_acquisition_recommended: The retained gap contains a tiny tops_list.csv under combo_activity_test and a13.15MB compressed combination-kinetics notebook, not an identified matched F/I dataset. A large notebook or further blind directory search is not justified to restate selected curves.

selection_against_alternatives.R19_S5: Deferred: its state-preferential premise fails representative sensitivity; functional recognition remains an untested possibility.
selection_against_alternatives.Zn45_Y152F_I: Preferred consequential uncertainty: directly observed contrasting substitutions remove the same hydroxyl but differ in packing. A matched kinetic comparison could correct the chemistry-to-activity rule without changing the substrate or inventing a new design.
selection_against_alternatives.catalytic_donor_geometry: Zn45_v2 Y122 substitution causes about10-fold activity loss and nearby V121I gives1.941-fold initial-screen signal in the parent background. A matched V121I x Y122 perturbation could test donor geometry, but those observations currently differ in background/endpoint and would require an additional matched series. It is less direct for deciding whether donor removal itself explains the existing Y152 contrast.
selection_against_alternatives.base_or_metal_knockout: Whole-active-site dependence is already experimentally supported. Another knockout is a competence control; it does not resolve the sign of a noncatalytic contact contribution.
selection_against_alternatives.further_geometry_curation: The passing-state check already defeats the specific R19 premise. Stop; additional static contact enumeration will not determine kinetic or free-energy effects.
selection_against_alternatives.direct_source_comparison: The direct author-data analysis supplies this decision. No Atlas advantage or prospective predictive validity is established.

execution_boundary: No model generation, assay, outreach, ordering or laboratory activity was performed. This worker used retained sources only; the sibling model-sensitivity task acquired the three additional author predictions under its separate root authorization. The replacement remains a bounded scientific decision requiring future laboratory authorization/access, not an executed experiment.

static_model_comparison_status.interpretation: The retained partial directory cannot supply all 15 intended samples. Missing cached entries do not establish absence from the author archive; WT and I alone cannot answer the fixed comparison. No coordinate model acquisition or measurement followed.
